title: Who receives an agency's material
description: The companies the Production Tool sends client material to, and what decides it (features/tenant-limits.clan). The Data sharing sheet is built from this file and the agency's allowlist; subprocessors.md is generated from it (python production-tool/contracts/subprocessors.py --write) and check.py fails when the two differ. A region is given only when it is confirmed, with its source. Contract 3.

id.description: For control 'maker', the maker id the capability sheets use.

does.description: What it does for the tool, in one line.

receives.description: What it receives from a job.

via.description: The entry whose service carries the material to it (a maker's model reached through Runway's API).

region.description: Where it processes the material; null until confirmed.

source.description: Where this was confirmed: a document, a file in the repository, or a written answer.

control.description: always: every agency uses it. claude: on while allow.claude is. maker: on while the maker is in allow.makers.
